g.text: Weight-Stationary Systolic Unit with Internal Pipeline Registers & MAC Core
Weight-Stationary Arch | INT8 Weights & Acts | INT32 Acc

circle.onmouseover: showTooltip(event, 'Port: weight_in [7:0] (Shifts weights from top neighbor)')
showTooltip(event, 'Port: weight_out [7:0] (Passes weight down to bottom neighbor)')
showTooltip(event, 'Port: a_in [7:0] (Activation entering from left neighbor)')
showTooltip(event, 'Port: a_out [7:0] (Registered activation leaving to right neighbor)')
showTooltip(event, 'Port: sum_in [31:0] (Partial sum from top neighbor)')
showTooltip(event, 'Port: sum_out [31:0] (Accumulated sum to bottom neighbor)')
